Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Cat.Overview.Title: Overview & Presets
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Cat.Overview.Body: See your active setup or switch between the 4 built-in presets. Hover or click any option to see what it changes and how heavy it is.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Cat.Antialiasing.B: Smooths jagged model edges, sharpens soft frames, or scales render resolution. Use FXAA or SMAA for smooth editing; try TAA or MSAA for cleaner thin outlines.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Cat.Shadows.Title: Shadows & Detail
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Cat.Shadows.Body: Controls shadow sharpness and softening, crevice contact shadows (SSAO), angled texture clarity, and preview outline thickness.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Cat.Gi.Title: Pipeline & Lighting
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Cat.Gi.Body: Switch between Forward, Clustered Forward, and Path Tracing, and tune indirect bounced lighting (GI) or ray bounces.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Cat.Post.Title: Post & Diffusion
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Cat.Post.Body: Adds a soft glow around bright areas. Built-in presets leave it off to keep original colors crisp; turn it on when you want a dreamy look.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Cat.Diagnostics.Bo: Choose whether preview SSAA drops automatically when VRAM gets tight, and check if your GPU supports DXR, FSR, XeSS, and DLSS.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.preset.performance: FXAA, 4× AF, and 1024 shadows with GI and diffusion off. Lightest on the GPU, great for scrubbing timelines or laptops.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.preset.balanced.Bo: SMAA High, 8× AF, and 2048 shadows. Keeps the classic MMD look with clean edges and steady frame rates.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.preset.high.Title: Preset: High
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.preset.high.Body: MSAA 4×, 16× AF, 4096 PCF soft shadows, and scene mipmaps. Cleaner outlines, softer shadows, and sharper floors at higher GPU cost.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.preset.ultra.Title: Preset: Ultra Ray-Traced
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.preset.ultra.Body: Enables hardware DXR one-bounce GI (falls back to software GI) with toon bands, ray-traced occlusion, and 4096 soft shadows. Heavy GPU load.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Aa.FollowScene.Bod: Uses the scene's own antialiasing choice without overriding it. Pick a mode here to take manual control.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Aa.Off.Title: AA: Off
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Aa.Off.Body: Turns off antialiasing for maximum speed, leaving visible jaggies on hair and thin diagonal lines.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Aa.Fxaa.Title: FXAA (Fast Approximate)
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Aa.Fxaa.Body: Ultra-fast edge smoothing that clears most jaggies, though fine textures and thin outlines soften slightly. Great for low-end GPUs or fast scrubbing.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Aa.Smaa.Title: SMAA 1×
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Aa.Smaa.Body: Smooths jagged edges without blurring textures or text. Modest GPU cost and the reliable default for MMD.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Aa.Taa.Title: TAA (Built-in Temporal)
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Aa.Taa.Body: Blends recent frames to stop fine shimmering and jaggies. Very smooth when still or moving slowly; fast motion can soften slightly (pair with RCAS to crisp it back up).
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Aa.Msaa2x.Title: MSAA 2×
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Aa.Msaa2x.Body: Hardware 2× edge sampling with zero texture blur or motion ghosting, great for thin outlines and hair. Slight extra VRAM cost; does not smooth alpha-cutout interiors.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Aa.Msaa4x.Title: MSAA 4×
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Aa.Msaa4x.Body: Hardware 4× edge sampling for clean outlines and hair with zero ghosting. Noticeably higher VRAM and GPU cost.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Aa.Msaa8x.Title: MSAA 8×
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Aa.Msaa8x.Body: Maximum hardware edge sampling for near-flawless outlines, at heavy VRAM and GPU cost. Best for inspecting still frames on fast GPUs.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.aa.smaaQuality.Bod: Applies only when SMAA is selected. Higher presets clean up shallow diagonal edges better for a tiny extra GPU cost.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.aa.ssaa.Title: Spatial Supersampling (SSAA)
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.aa.ssaa.Body: Renders the whole frame multiple times and downsamples it, smoothing both edges and textures. Multiplies GPU time and VRAM; keep 1× for daily editing.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.aa.renderScale.Bod: Scales internal resolution (50%–150%). Lower boosts FPS and saves VRAM; higher looks crisper at higher GPU cost. Locked to 100% with upscaling or SSAA.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Temporal.Off.Title: Temporal Upscaling: Off
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Temporal.Off.Body: Renders directly using your chosen AA and render scale without vendor temporal upscalers.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Temporal.Fsr.Title: Temporal Upscaling: AMD FSR
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Temporal.Fsr.Body: Renders at a lower resolution and rebuilds sharp frames using motion history, boosting FPS while keeping edges tidy. Replaces regular AA.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Temporal.XeSs.Body: Rebuilds crisp high-res detail from lower-resolution frames using motion history. Replaces regular AA and locks render scale.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Temporal.Dlss.Body: AI upscaling (or native-res DLAA) on supported NVIDIA RTX GPUs for clean edges and strong FPS gains. Requires matching drivers and runtime files.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.temporal.quality.B: Chooses the internal resolution ratio: Performance renders fewer pixels for higher FPS; Native AA stays at 100% resolution for pure antialiasing.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.sharpening.enabled: Gently brings back hair and texture crispness after TAA, FXAA, or diffusion without needing FSR 1. Push it too far and white edge halos appear.
Lower values sharpen more (0 = strongest, 2 = softest). Values around 0.2–0.5 look natural.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Fsr1.Off.Title: Spatial Upscaling (FSR 1): Off
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Fsr1.On.Title: Spatial Upscaling (FSR 1)
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Fsr1.On.Body: Renders lower-res and upscales each frame independently, so there's zero motion ghosting. Fast, though thin hair can shimmer more than TAA.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.fsr1.quality.Title: FSR 1 Preset
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.fsr1.quality.Body: Ultra Quality renders ~77% scale; Performance renders 50%. Lower presets run faster with softer detail.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.fsr1.rcasEnabled.B: FSR 1's own sharpening step after upscaling. Avoid enabling both this and standalone RCAS at once.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.fsr1.rcasSharpness: Controls FSR 1 built-in sharpening strength: 0 is sharpest, 2 is softest.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.SurfaceOrder.Opaqu: Draws opaque surfaces before transparent ones to avoid alpha sorting artifacts. Recommended default.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.SurfaceOrder.Origi: Follows the exact PMX material list order for legacy models that rely on manual material ordering.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.shadow.res.Title: Shadow Map Resolution
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.shadow.res.Body: Higher resolution gives cleaner shadow edges with fewer jaggies; 4096 uses ~4× the shadow VRAM of 2048. Set to 0 to turn self-shadows off.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.ShadowFilter.Linea: Default hardware smoothing. Slightly softer than Sharp Pixel at virtually zero cost, great for everyday editing.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.ShadowFilter.Point: No smoothing between shadow texels, giving crisp, blocky hard edges similar to classic MMD shadows.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.ShadowFilter.PcfSo: Samples around each shadow edge to turn jagged steps into smooth soft shadows. Tune the width with PCF Softness below; modest extra GPU cost.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.shadow.softness.Bo: Only active with Soft Shadow (PCF). Higher values spread the shadow edge wider; 0 is nearly hard, and 1.0–1.5 usually looks natural.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.ssao.enabled.Title: Screen-Space AO (GTAO / SSAO)
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.ssao.enabled.Body: Adds soft contact darkening in folds, corners, and under feet so characters feel grounded. Cannot run with Ray GI occlusion; off by default.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.ssao.strength.Body: Sets how dark contact shadows get (0–1). Around 0.2–0.5 suits toon characters; higher values can make skin and pale outfits look muddy.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.ssao.radius.Title: SSAO Radius
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.ssao.radius.Body: Sets how wide crevices reach (0.1–8). Small values shade fine fabric folds; larger values darken room corners.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.ssao.samples.Title: SSAO Sample Count
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.ssao.samples.Body: Samples per pixel (4 / 8 / 16). 8 balances smoothness and speed; 16 reduces grain at higher GPU cost.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Aniso.Off.Title: Anisotropic Filtering: Off (1×)
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Aniso.Off.Body: Uses standard texture sampling; floors and walls viewed at shallow angles turn blurry in the distance.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Aniso.On.Title: Anisotropic Filtering (2×–16×)
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Aniso.On.Body: Keeps angled floors, stages, and distant walls crisp. Even 16× costs almost nothing on modern GPUs.
Generates mipmaps only for environment and prop textures to stop distant shimmering. Character textures are never altered.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.detail.outlineEnab: Shows or hides model outlines in the preview viewport only without changing your project or PMX files.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.detail.outlineScal: Temporarily scales outline thickness (0–4×) for previewing at different resolutions.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Pipeline.Forward.B: Reliable default pipeline with full MMD shading and style-plugin compatibility. Best for everyday editing and simple lighting.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Pipeline.Clustered: Groups lights into 3D screen clusters so scenes with many point or spot lights run much faster, while keeping MSAA, TAA, and style plugins.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Pipeline.PathTraci: Traces multi-bounce rays for soft shadows, color bleeding, and reflections, getting cleaner whenever the camera stops moving. Heavy GPU load; disables raster AA, shadow maps, SSAO, and one-bounce GI.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Pt.ShadingToonHybr: Keeps MMD toon ramps, outlines, and original character colors while adding ray-traced soft shadows and gentle bounced light.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Pt.ShadingPhysical: Switches to physically based diffuse and glossy reflections for realistic lighting and material checks.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.pt.samples.Title: Samples per Frame
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.pt.samples.Body: Rays traced per pixel each frame (1–64). Keeping 1 with progressive accumulation feels snappy; higher values clear noise faster per frame but cut FPS proportionally.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.pt.bounces.Title: Max Bounces
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.pt.bounces.Body: How many times light can bounce (1–8). 2–4 gives natural color bleeding; higher values brighten enclosed rooms at extra GPU cost.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.pt.progressive.Bod: Keeps stacking samples while the camera and scene are still, clearing up grain within seconds. Turn off to re-render each frame fresh.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Pt.DenoiserOff.Bod: Shows raw noisy samples with no smoothing, useful for inspecting true convergence.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Pt.DenoiserSpatial: Smooths noise inside each single frame while keeping edges intact. Helps during playback or camera drags with zero motion ghosting.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Pt.DenoiserTempora: Combines past frames with edge-aware smoothing (default) so the image cleans up quickly even at low sample counts.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.pt.maxAccum.Title: Max Accumulated Frames
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.pt.maxAccum.Body: Stops stacking frames after this limit (1–4096). 128–256 is usually plenty without keeping your GPU pinned at 100%.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.pt.interactiveSamp: Caps samples per frame while rotating the camera or playing motion (1–16) so controls stay responsive, then resumes full samples when still.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.pt.firefly.Title: Firefly Clamp
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.pt.firefly.Body: Caps extreme bright speckles caused by strong reflections (1–1000). Lower values remove more sparkles, though intense highlights may dim slightly.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.pt.hardwareRt.Body: Uses hardware ray-tracing cores when supported, and falls back smoothly to software BVH compute if your GPU lacks DXR 1.1.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Gi.Off.Title: Ray GI: Off
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Gi.Off.Body: Direct light and self-shadows only. Fastest and keeps original MMD lighting unchanged.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Gi.Software.Title: Ray GI: Software
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Gi.Software.Body: Computes one-bounce indirect light via shaders on any SM 6.0 GPU without needing DXR hardware, at higher GPU cost than hardware RT.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Gi.Hardware.Title: Ray GI: Hardware DXR
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Gi.Hardware.Body: Hardware DXR acceleration for one-bounce indirect light and subtle color bleeding. Faster than software GI on DXR-capable GPUs.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.gi.strength.Title: GI Strength
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.gi.strength.Body: Scales how bright bounced indirect light looks. Too high can wash out shadows, so tune it by eye.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.gi.acceleration.Bo: Traces GI at half resolution during live preview for higher FPS; exports always render at full resolution.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Gi.CompAdditive.Bo: Adds bounced light straight onto surface colors. Natural for realistic props, but softens cel-shaded shadow steps.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.Gi.CompToonPalette: Routes bounced light through the character's toon ramp, keeping crisp cel-shaded blocks while picking up ambient color.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.gi.toonResponse.Bo: Preserve Palette Bands keeps crisp cel-shaded steps; Continuous blends smoothly across shadow edges.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.gi.denoiser.Title: GI Denoiser
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.gi.denoiser.Body: Cleans up grainy GI noise (Toon Palette mode only). Temporal + Spatial is smoothest; Spatial avoids motion ghosting.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.gi.occlusionStreng: Uses GI rays to darken tight crevices and corners (0 = off). Cannot be combined with SSAO when above 0.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.gi.occlusionRadius: How far Ray GI checks for nearby blockers when darkening crevices. Must be larger than Ray Epsilon when active.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.gi.samples.Title: GI Samples per Pixel
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.gi.samples.Body: Bounce rays traced per pixel (1–1024). 8–16 is usually plenty with denoising on; higher values slow frame rates directly.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.gi.maxRayDist.Body: How far GI bounce rays travel. Too short misses distant walls; increase it for very large stages.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.gi.directScale.Bod: Scales how much direct light feeds into the indirect bounce (default 1.0). Leave at 1.0 unless fine-tuning bounce brightness.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.gi.rayEpsilon.Body: Tiny offset keeping rays from hitting their own surface and causing black speckles (default 0.002). Only tweak for unusually tiny or huge models.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.gi.seed.Title: Random Seed
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.gi.seed.Body: Locks the random sampling pattern so repeated renders produce the exact same noise layout.
Adds a soft glow over bright areas at the end of the frame while keeping grid lines, bones, and gizmos crisp.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.diffusion.strength: Controls how strong the glow mixes in (0–1). Higher values make the image dreamier and softer.
Mda.Text.Preview.Help.diffusion.extent.B: Sets how far the glow spreads outward (0–0.01). Even small values create a gentle halo.
On by default: temporarily lowers preview SSAA when VRAM runs tight to prevent crashes, without changing your saved settings.
